question: What claim is made about the teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters such that its transmission is attributed to a single earth-mover?
premises: A teaching concerns the earth-moving good-eaters.
It was told by an earth-mover to the beloved one.
inference: The teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters was told by an earth-mover, O beloved one.
uncertainties: The content of that teaching is not stated here.
plain_english: O beloved, the teaching concerning the earth-moving good-eaters was told by an earth-mover.
